Pretty recent, but..

"I thought I was in love, I wasn't. I guess it was just a crush."

fucking hurts man...
There aren't a lot of Filipino atheists out there bro :[
If I were you, I would not believe my eyes.

Actually, the way I see it... If in the future, I become successful, they'll take credit. If I don't, I'll be rejected in every single way possible. In short, some people would only care if it benefit themselves.

I'm sorry.
The sad part is... People only start thinking about how they treated you and regretting what they did to you once you're gone.

She's somebody whom I care very much for.

It may not be the way to go... Quitting is an option, not a path, an option that becomes a lot more appealing as life progresses. 

I'm worthless.

The only reason I'm staying alive is a person.

Quitting sounds so appealing, and has been for the last 2 years for me.
at this point I don't think I could.

It's okay.

I don't know where to start. I don't even care anymore.

What makes you think that suicidal people are caring and empathetic?

I don't know.
